metaTitle: Dzvin for organizations — support and pilots
metaDescription: Explore Dzvin for organizations: employee access, organizational tools, privacy boundaries and a scoped pilot.
title: Support people. Build stronger teams.
subtitle: Employees get a personal space for everyday self-support. Dzvin is developing separate organizational tools and role-restricted aggregate analytics for organizations.
availability: Business capabilities are in development. Demonstrations cover existing functionality; pilot scope is agreed individually.
privacy: Private journals are not an employer reporting tool. Organizational views require explicit access rights and safeguards for small groups.
features: Personal Dzvin access for voluntary employee support
Permitted aggregate information to help understand team needs
process: Discuss your team's needs and context
Review current capabilities and agree pilot boundaries
Define a launch scope and evaluation criteria
formSubtitle: Share work contact details and a short request. No employee health details or private journal entries are needed.
